items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Wilson Myers was playing with Willie Lewis, not as a bass, but as a conga drummer or something.

ctx.x: Who were the Three Dukes, then? An act?

An act. Bobby Mosely. Bubba Gaines, who is now with the dancers, the group of dancers now with Honi Coles. Arthur Russell. Those were the Three Dukes. And Wilson Myers came over; we were together. Wilson Myers was playing with Willie Lewis, not as a bass, but as a conga drummer or something. Everybody was trying to get home, you see! He was going, but.... You know, me and Willie had the same passes at the same time.
We left that one Saturday night at 11 o'clock. It took us eight days to get through the English Channel, because it was heavily mined. Eight days to get out of the Channel.
